_meta.company: Stealth Physical AI Startup (via Jack & Jill)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience fine-tuning vision-language models and deploying real-time perception systems on physical hardware. Fine-tuned DONUT (VLM) at IIT Bombay achieving 55%→93% accuracy; built a physical AI pipeline—voice intent, TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS, robotic actuation—on NVIDIA Jetson as MS capstone.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free vision-language model) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.
Built PyTorch training pipelines to standardize VLM fine-tuning and evaluation workflows.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error; architected a full surface inspection perception pipeline with image stitching, wavelet denoising, and PSNR 86 output.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation.
Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove with ADXL345 and Raspberry Pi Pico, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a full physical AI pipeline: voice → intent (Gemini) → TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS → robotic actuation on NVIDIA Jetson.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency; resolved 11 integration failures across perception, servo, and depth sensing.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Generated ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation via semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated zero collisions across multiple laps with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e; AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains (0T6); validated against MoveIt and RViz.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time tracking; FreeRTOS task coordination with VL53L0X ToF for distance-aware targeting.
